laws.rule: Skadar Lake National Park entry €5 (about A$7.95 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) per person per day (includes visitor centre and educational trails). A 2026 annual ticket for all five national parks costs €13.50. Includes the Vranjina and Virpazar visitor centres.
